session_summary: A patient visited the doctor for persistent headaches, high blood pressure, and dizziness. The doctor prescribed medication, recommended lifestyle changes, and scheduled follow-up tests and appointments.

proposed_actions.title: Reduce Coffee Intake
proposed_actions.description: Reduce coffee consumption to at most one cup per day in the morning.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Please reduce your coffee to at most one a day, in the morning.

proposed_actions.title: Monitor Blood Pressure
proposed_actions.description: Measure blood pressure twice daily, in the morning and evening, and record the values in a notebook.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want you to measure your blood pressure at home twice a day, in the morning and in the evening, and note the values in a notebook.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Blood Tests
proposed_actions.description: Complete blood tests (cholesterol, blood sugar, creatinine, and electrolyte panel) by Wednesday.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Please do them by Wednesday, without fail.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Electrocardiogram
proposed_actions.description: Undergo an electrocardiogram at the outpatient clinic with the assistant.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: we'll do it right here, with the assistant, after the consultation.

proposed_actions.title: Follow-Up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Attend a follow-up appointment on Friday, November 13th, at 10 o'clock.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Please come back on Friday, November 13th, at 10 o'clock

proposed_actions.title: Take Prescribed Medication
proposed_actions.description: Take amlodipine 5 milligrams once daily in the morning as prescribed.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll prescribe you amlodipine 5 milligrams, one tablet in the morning.

decisions: The patient will continue taking the medication for now.
The patient will be referred for blood tests and an electrocardiogram.
risks: If the patient's blood pressure exceeds 180 or symptoms like numbness, blurred vision, or chest pain occur, they must call 122 immediately.
follow_up_questions: Is there a specific time frame for the follow-up appointment?
Are there any additional lifestyle changes the patient should consider?
